{{Quote|I intend to go to my quarters and bite the head off a frozen ormachek.|Ackbar|<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>}}
An '''ormachek''' was a creature that was eaten by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] for its memory enhancing qualities. It could be frozen.
